one_liner: Fanbasis (creator payments/checkout) has a REST public API at fanbasis.com/public-api using x-api-key, with scopes and webhooks; no official MCP found.
auth_notes: Public API uses an x-api-key header from the seller dashboard, with scopes. A third-party doc says there is no OAuth. Aura's docs mention OAuth 2.0 with PKCE for a gated partner integration, which isn't documented for general developers.
access_notes: API keys are generated in the seller/merchant dashboard under the API section. No plan gating was found, but this is inferred. Sandbox and production environments exist. The seller account must be approved for payments.
blocker_notes: The only caveat is that the docs we found are mostly GitHub mirrors and third-party pages; the official docs are at apidocs.fan.

evidence.quote: No OAuth, no client ID/secret pairs — Fanbasis uses a single API key with separate test/live environments.
You can find your API key in your merchant dashboard under the API section.
Full Fanbasis API integration: checkout sessions, customers, subscribers, discount codes, products, transactions, refunds, and webhook management.
Zapier FanBasis MCP lets you connect FanBasis's actions with any AI tool that supports MCP
